title: Divisible
description: The exercise template includes a template for the method `public static ArrayList divisible(ArrayList numbers)`. Implement a functionality there that gathers numbers divisible by two, three or five from the list it receives as a parameter, and returns them as a new list. The list received as a parameter must not be altered.
